dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I cảm thấy an toàn when đi walking on đường phố in Saigon during buổi tối. Phụ nữ in Russia don't dare to go out alone.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Really? America is the same, many areas aren't an toàn for phụ nữ. I like that Vietnam has many people on đường phố at night.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: That's right, the đường phố here are always crowded. But sometimes I find the way Vietnamese men look at me... a bit strange.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Maybe because you're a beautiful foreigner. But I understand that uncomfortable cảm thấy. I could đi with you during buổi tối if you want to feel more an toàn.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: You think I need protection? I play chess, I know how to calculate every situation. But... if you want to đi with me, I won't refuse.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: So tomorrow buổi tối would you like to take a walk and tell me more about your thoughts on an toàn for phụ nữ in Vietnam? TITLE_CARD: Safe Streets for Women?
